Service Agreement

Terms & Conditions

Clear, transparent operational standards for doorstep laundry pickup, washing, and delivery in Nairobi.

1. Service Scope & Booking

WashFlow provides on-demand doorstep laundry collection, washing, tumble-drying, steam pressing, and delivery across Nairobi. By scheduling a pickup online or creating an account, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.

2. Unit Pricing & Catalog Transparency

Prices listed on our live catalog are fixed by service tier (Everyday Basket loads, Duvet dimensions, and Floor Mat sizes). Final order amounts are confirmed upon digital booking and verified during dispatch inspection. No surprise fees or scale adjustments are introduced without customer consent.

3. Payments via M-Pesa

All transactions are conducted in Kenyan Shillings (KES) securely via Safaricom M-Pesa (Daraja API). Customers may complete payment upon delivery inspection or via instant STK push at booking. An official receipt is automatically generated and confirmed via WhatsApp.

4. Referral Program, Loyalty Points & Reward Vouchers

4.1 Referral Qualification & Points Award

Existing clients ("Referrers") earn 100 referral points for each new client ("Referee") they invite, strictly upon meeting all qualification conditions: (a) the referee must be a genuinely new customer with no prior account, phone number, or booking in the WashFlow database; (b) the referee must complete their first laundry order through to verified DELIVERED status; (c) payment must be successfully settled and reconciled via verified M-Pesa callback for an amount of at least the minimum qualifying order value (currently KES 300); and (d) the order must not be cancelled, refunded, or disputed. Attribution is permanently locked upon initial account creation.

4.2 Milestone Thresholds & Reward Caps

Referral points accumulate toward distinct milestone tiers:

  • Standard Milestone (500 Points / 5 Qualified Referrals): Entitles the referrer to choose one free laundry line from an eligible catalog set: Small Basket (up to 7 kg), Single / 3x5 Duvet, or Small Doormat / Bath Mat, capped at KES 300.
  • Exclusive Milestone (1,000 Points / 10 Qualified Referrals): Entitles the referrer to one free Large Basket (up to 15 kg), capped at KES 450.

Rewards reference authoritative price catalog IDs. Any excess weight, specialty items, or additional laundry lines beyond the promotional item are billed at standard catalog rates. Vouchers cannot be combined with other discount codes or stacked on a single booking.

4.3 Loyalty Points Program

Clients earn 10 loyalty points on every completed, paid laundry order. Loyalty points are awarded solely on the paid cash portion of an order; washes covered entirely by a reward voucher earn 0 loyalty points. Accumulating 100 loyalty points entitles the client to redeem one free Small Basket wash (capped at KES 300).

4.4 Administrative Review & Fraud Prevention

To preserve fair play, all milestone reward entitlements undergo an administrative review and security check before a redeemable voucher is generated. WashFlow employs automated fraud detection: matching M-Pesa phone numbers, duplicate device or browser fingerprints, delivery address proximity, velocity anomalies, and circular referral rings are strictly prohibited. Referrals flagged for fraud or self-referral will be voided without compensation.

4.5 Reversals & Order Cancellations

In the event a qualifying order is subsequently refunded, cancelled, or disputed, associated referral and loyalty points will be reversed via negative ledger entries. Any pending reward entitlement will be voided. If a voucher has already been approved or redeemed on a reversed order, the client's account will be flagged for administrative dispute resolution.

4.6 Voucher Validity, Non-Transferability & Expiry

Issued reward vouchers are valid for 90 days from the date of administrative approval. Expired vouchers cannot be reissued or reinstated. Loyalty points remain active for 12 months of account activity; inactivity exceeding 12 months may result in points expiration following advance notice. Referral points do not expire. Vouchers and points have zero cash redemption value, are non-transferable, and cannot be bartered or sold.

4.7 Tax & Accounting Disclaimer

Promotional points, milestone entitlements, and vouchers constitute non-cash promotional discounts offered at WashFlow's sole discretion. Participants are solely responsible for determining any personal tax liabilities that may arise in connection with receipt or redemption of promotional discounts under the laws of Kenya.

5. Damaged / Lost Items Policy

WashFlow handles each individual drum load with high standards of care. In the rare event an item is misplaced or damaged during washing or transit:

  • Claims must be reported to customer support via WhatsApp or email within 24 hours of delivery.
  • Customers must inspect garments upon delivery before accepting handoff from the courier.
  • Verified claims are reviewed within 48 hours and compensated in accordance with fair depreciated market value up to KES 5,000 per order or through service credit vouchers.

6. Governing Law

These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Kenya.
